name: Foundgine
description: Foundgine semantic execution layer and MCP adapter for exposing authorized, provider-neutral application capabilities to AI agents.

tools.name: foundgine_capabilities
tools.purpose: Discover the semantic capability contract available to the current caller.

tools.name: foundgine_query
tools.purpose: Execute provider-neutral read intent through the Foundgine planning and execution pipeline.

tools.name: foundgine_mutation_dry_run
tools.purpose: Validate and authorize a mutation without executing it.

tools.name: foundgine_mutation_approve
tools.purpose: Create an approval bound to an authorized mutation plan.

tools.name: foundgine_mutation_execute_approved
tools.purpose: Execute an approved mutation after authorization and plan-fingerprint revalidation.
